arStrings.szText:
When fighting a Boss in a Nightmare Dungeon, the {c_important}Beast in Ice{/c} has a chance to appear and attack you.

When this occurs, killing the Nightmare Dungeon Boss has a chance to drop {c_unique}Unique{/c} Items from the {c_important}Beast in Ice's{/c} {u}{b}{c_important}Hoard Chest{/c}{/b}{/u}.
